$comment: Editor wiring (VS Code settings.json): "json.schemas": [{"fileMatch": ["sora-extension.json"], "url": "./schema/manifest.schema.json"}]. The CLI validate command enforces the rules this schema can only approximate (path safety, key formats, cross-field checks).
description: sora-extension.json — normative spec: docs/extensions.md. The sora-ext CLI (validate/publish) is authoritative; this schema powers editor autocomplete and hover.

identity.description: Verifiable handle, e.g. github:janedoe or an https URL.

name.description: Display name of the author, e.g. Jane Doe.

public_key.description: Minisign public key that signed the package (the base64 line of a .pub file). Paste the output of `sora-ext keygen` here.

background_task.description: Optional: one periodic background task. Needs the background capability AND permission. The runtime clamps the effective interval into [15 min, 7 days].

entry.description: Worker script inside the package, e.g. worker.js. Relative .js path, no traversal.

interval_minutes.description: Desired period in whole minutes. Below 15 min is clamped to 15 min by the runtime.

capabilities.description: Coarse feature areas. The permission list is what actually gates access. May be omitted: both real parsers treat a missing list as empty.

description.description: One or two sentences shown under the name in the store card.

id.description: Reverse-DNS id with at least two labels, e.g. com.example.stats. Stable forever: the app uses it to track installs and updates.

manifest_version.description: Must be 1. This is the only manifest version current Sora understands.

min_app_version.description: Oldest Sora version this extension works with, e.g. 1.9.0.

name.description: Display name shown in the Extensions section.

network_hook.description: Optional: DPI-bypass module descriptor (v0 contract, proposed). Needs the network-hook capability AND the net.hooks permission. No runtime consumer runs hooks yet.

entry.description: Hook descriptor inside the package, e.g. hook.json. Relative .json path, no traversal.

network_hosts.description: Host allowlist for net.fetch (needs the net.fetch permission). Lowercase DNS names or wildcards like *.example.com. No IPs, schemes, ports or paths.

permissions.description: Fine-grained access. The install prompt lists them; dangerous ones need explicit confirmation. Request only what you need. May be omitted: both real parsers (core/ext, app/lib/src/ext) treat a missing list as empty.

routing.description: Optional: routing-rules file (v0 contract, proposed). Needs the routing capability AND the routing.rules permission. No runtime consumer reads extension rules yet.

entry.description: Rules file inside the package, e.g. routing.json. Relative .json path, no traversal.

settings_schema.description: JSON-Schema subset for the extension's own settings. The app auto-generates the settings form from it.

default.description: Default value used until the user changes the setting.

enum.description: Allowed values (dropdown in the generated form).

theme.description: Optional: theme descriptor (v0 contract, proposed). Needs the theme capability AND the theme.apply permission. No runtime consumer applies themes yet.

entry.description: Theme descriptor inside the package, e.g. theme.json. Relative .json path, no traversal.

panels.description: Panels embedded in the app. Each is plain HTML/JS; the only bridge to the app is window.soraExt.

entry.description: Relative .html path inside the package, e.g. panel.html. No traversal.

id.description: Unique within the extension, e.g. main.

title.description: Tab title shown in the app.

version.description: Semver MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. The catalog uses it to detect updates.

title: Sora extension manifest (v1)
